claim_boundary: These are digitized curves from the visible PDF figures, not original author data. They are suitable for an auditable open Chrono table-law input, not for claiming exact Adams source-data recovery.

chrono_buffer_law.source: Thies 2022 Figures 4 and 5 digitized from supplied PDF page 7.
chrono_buffer_law.table_interface_note: Spring and damper curves are digitized from raster PDF figures; hard stop remains only a numerical guard beyond the digitized stroke range.

digitization.method: PyMuPDF page rendering, manual axis calibration, color-threshold curve extraction, and linear resampling.
digitization.force_sign_convention: Thies plots compression as negative force/displacement/velocity; Chrono table stores compression and resisting force as positive values.
digitization.hard_stop_note: The hard-stop terms are not digitized paper data; they are a numerical guard outside the digitized range.
